verses.verse:
लौहखण्डात् तु ताम्रम् स्यात् तस्माद्रजत खण्डकम्।
तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठं तु काष्ठं स्यात् सर्वस्माद् बंश खण्डकम्।।१२।।
verses.text: Copper is better than a piece of iron, and a piece of silver better than that; better than that is wood, and best of all is a piece of bamboo.

commentary.text: In the flute, nādotpatti (the production of sound) comes from the vibration of air, whatever solid casing that air may be enclosed in; even so, with different vessels there is always a subtle difference in the impact of the air. Among metals that conduct electricity, silver [and] aluminium are better than iron [and] copper, because it is good if the instrument is light. And non-conducting materials such as wood are said to be better than these. But bamboo, which produces supporting sounds through its aṇurandhra (micro-pores), is the best of all.

subsection.title: The Kinds of Flute and Suitable Materials
